# permio_check (Data Source)

Checks whether a principal holds permissions on a resource, exactly as your application's permission checks would: counting grants on the resource and its ancestors, `_` wildcard grants, roles and group memberships. Useful for policy tests, with `check` blocks or `terraform test`.

Data sources are read during planning, so a check that depends on grants created in the same run sees them only once they exist (on the next plan, or in a later `terraform test` run block).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Policy test: fail the plan if a contractor can delete production documents.
data "permio_check" "contractor_cannot_delete" {
  principal   = "user_contractor"
  resource    = "/workspaces/acme/environments/production"
  permissions = ["document.delete"]
}

check "contractor_cannot_delete" {
  assert {
    condition     = !data.permio_check.contractor_cannot_delete.allowed
    error_message = "Contractors must not be able to delete production documents."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission names the principal must hold (1 to 100).
- `principal` (String) Principal ID to check: a user or service ID, or `group:<name>`.
- `resource` (String) Resource URI to check.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `allowed` (Boolean) Whether the principal holds every permission on the resource.
- `missing` (Set of String) The requested permissions the principal does not hold.
